pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, star-like polygonal patches with high edge angularity and sharp pixel-level transitions between dark and light regions. Spatial area of patches is variable, with many exhibiting concave 'leaf-like' indentations.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of thick, light-pigmented pathways. The topology features a high density of 3-way and 4-way junction nodes, with pathway thickness remaining relatively uniform across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, stiff, dark-brown bristled mane with a consistent, low-amplitude sawtooth silhouette against the sky/background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Fine, horizontal linear marks of lighter pigment are visible on the mid-flank, likely representing superficial healed scratches.
other_distinctive_markers: Three avian organisms (oxpeckers) are visible perched directly on the dorsal ridge of the neck and upper shoulder.
